content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the šiauliai district court the case involves a matrimonial property dispute between two parties whose names are not provided the court declares the dissolution of the marriage and determines that a car with the license plate volvo mv 84 is the personal property of one of the parties this party is also responsible for any debts related to the car the text discusses various articles from the civil code related to matrimonial property division the applicant referred to as rv is seeking the annulment of their marriage and certain arrangements regarding their minor son they are also seeking financial maintenance and the return of a car registered in the other partys name the defendant denies the allegations the court will make a decision on the division of property maintenance payments and costs incurred considering the best interests of the child the application and counterclaim were partially granted and the marriage will be dissolved due to fault rv is responsible for fulfilling their personal obligation to a debt creditor and for the costs of the court proceedings
